name: snap-back
description: Undo for coding agents. Snapshots the project into a shadow git repository so one command rolls back what the agent did, without touching your own git history.

interface.longDescription: snap-back keeps snapshots of the project in a private git repository outside the project directory, so it never touches your own .git, branches, index or stash. The plugin adds a skill that has Codex take a labelled checkpoint before risky changes (large refactors, codemods, deletions, shell commands that rewrite files) and roll back cleanly when you ask it to undo. For checkpoints around a whole Codex session, start Codex with snap-back wrap -- codex. Only files inside the project are covered: database writes, installs outside the project and pushed commits cannot be undone. Requires Node 20+ and git.
capabilities: Takes labelled checkpoints of the project before risky changes
Shows what changed since any checkpoint
Rolls files back to a checkpoint, with a safety snapshot first
defaultPrompt: Take a snap-back checkpoint, then refactor this module
Show what changed since the last snap-back checkpoint
Undo the changes from my last request with snap-back
